disclosure_basis: 2026Q3 10-Q filed10/29 and Q2 10-Q; re-read2026-11-10; no new Nov9 Google filing
units: USD billions unless per-share USD or days

tpu_unit_model.formula: NWC = revenue*DSO/365 + revenue*(1-gross_margin)*(DIO-DPO)/365; first ramp-year gross cash = revenue*gross_margin - deltaNWC
exclusions: Operating expenses, tax, depreciation, maintenance/growth capex, lease payments and return/repurchase provisions not estimated here.
Gross-cash subtotal is neither FCFF nor net profit nor company guidance.
DeltaNWC is a one-off ramp investment at this incremental sales level; do not subtract the full stock again every subsequent year.
TPU-only sales, gross margin, AR and inventory not separately disclosed. All-company inventory also includes Pixel.
No contribution from customer prepayments assumed in this model; actual contract prepayments could lower cash use.
Do not subtract modeled cash-PPE again for inventory and do not apply the full company capex ratio to product units without allocation.

conclusion: 本次完成现金流口径和每100亿美元新增TPU销售的周转模型；不因高增长恢复旧买价。现价判断仍为未证实低估，完整经营预测与融资后估值未完成。
model_boundary: FCF less SBC is a non-GAAP analyst economic proxy, not actual cash outflow and not normalized future cash flow. If EBIT already retains SBC in DCF, do not subtract SBC again.
